verdict.rationale: The docs show a very short path to a working installed skill: run `$skill-installer linear` (or install by GitHub URL) inside Codex, or use `/plugins` to install from a marketplace, start a new session, then invoke the skill via `/skills` or `$`. Skill structure is also minimal (a directory with a `SKILL.md` containing name and description). missing for 10: a dedicated end-to-end skills quickstart page with an explicit time-to-first-skill claim, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the flow takes under five minutes.
